note: The maintainer asked for this release after the dossier UI rebuild across the desktop app, phone app, website and extension. The installer, setup, live research, follow-up, compare, stop, reconnect and upgrade journeys were not walked on this build; release_readiness.py is expected to refuse complete stable-readiness certification. The packaged build, the frozen sidecar harness, the built app's start, the extracted portable copy's start and the catalogs were observed.

fresh_install.evidence: The installer was built and hashed; it was not run because Kriko 0.3.9 is installed on this machine and the install smoke refuses to replace it.

portable_start.evidence: Extracted kriko-0.3.10-win64-portable.zip; kriko.exe stayed up 22 s with its own kriko-sidecar.exe beside it and a responding window titled Kriko, then was stopped.

setup.evidence: More -> Set up Kriko was not walked on the packaged window.

sourced_answer.evidence: No live research was run on the packed 0.3.10 engine; the change is presentation only and the frozen sidecar's health check passed.

follow_up.evidence: Not walked on the packed engine.

compare.evidence: Compare was reviewed in the app but no live comparison was made on the packaged engine.

stop.evidence: Tray Quit was not walked; the smoke test ended the app by PID.

reconnect.evidence: Not walked on the packaged window.

upgrade_retains_data.evidence: No installed 0.3.9 to 0.3.10 upgrade was performed.

mistral-vibe.report: src/app/tests/test_the_mistral_agent_recovers.py and src/app/tests/test_a_host_read_turn_warms_its_agent.py: hosted-session rejection, start allowance and warm start

observed_instead: The UI rebuild was tested: desktop build, lint and 102 behaviour tests; extension 539 tests; website 45 tests plus the browser install/product checks; mobile typecheck, lint and the offline theme/i18n suite; the Python UI theme and extension-palette contracts and the generated-page checks.

The full Python suite was run on this tree. Eighteen failures remain in the agent-benchmark, ledger and sidecar tests; the two ledger/sidecar tests passed when re-run alone, and the rest depend on simulated-agent fixtures. None of them imports or exercises the UI files changed by this release.
Version agreement is strict at 0.3.10 across pyproject.toml, kriko-ui/src-tauri/Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, kriko-ui/package.json and the site links.

The full build recipe completed on this machine: the existing app-bound shared-access pepper was retained; OpenSERP 0.8.12 was already present and verified; the sidecar was frozen and answered; the web interface built; the app and the NSIS installer built; the built app stayed up 25 seconds and spawned its engine.

The frozen sidecar harness re-checked the handshake, /api/health, the log path, the API root, the extension and Firefox manifests, an empty fresh store, the benchmark corpus, the settings graphs, a lookup, a job failure, the MCP initialize and the terminal: all passed.
The portable archive was extracted and started: kriko.exe stayed up 22 seconds, responded, and had its own kriko-sidecar.exe beside it.

Artifacts: kriko-0.3.10-x86_64-setup.exe 37,404,268 bytes; kriko-0.3.10-win64-portable.zip 46,212,826 bytes; kriko-engine-0.3.10-win64.zip 32,275,407 bytes; kriko-extension-0.5.0.zip 314,024 bytes; SHA256SUMS.txt.

Catalogs: 32 .kpack builds, packs.json whose 32 rows are pinned to https://github.com/Berbadov/kriko/releases/download/v0.3.10, and packs-0.3.10.zip (33 entries, 2,401,827 bytes, sha256 cb3ae80ebac82dd3fcc1802bc04f268fd72e20afd4dc0af9e183377ebb1ba602). Every index row, size and digest was checked against the built files before upload.
The extension ZIP is the extension/ folder without tests/, built from this tree; manifest version 0.5.0.
The installer was not run, and no installed-version upgrade was performed, because Kriko 0.3.9 is present on this machine.
